questions.prompt: What is the primary goal of exploratory data analysis?
questions.explanation: EDA focuses on gaining insights and identifying patterns, not on model building or code production.

questions.prompt: Which plot is most appropriate to detect outliers in a univariate numeric variable?
questions.explanation: Boxplots display quartiles and outliers clearly, making them ideal for spotting extreme values.

questions.prompt: Which statistical measure is most robust to outliers when summarizing central tendency?
questions.explanation: The median is unaffected by extreme values, providing a reliable central estimate when outliers exist.

questions.prompt: If you observe a high correlation between two numeric features, what is a potential next step in EDA?
questions.explanation: High correlation can cause redundancy; dropping one simplifies subsequent modeling.

questions.prompt: Which technique helps reduce dimensionality while preserving variance in a dataset?
questions.explanation: PCA transforms features into orthogonal components that capture most of the data variance.

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the role of hypothesis generation in exploratory data analysis?

options.text: It is the final step before publishing results
It is a formal statistical test
It is an iterative process to propose explanations

questions.explanation: Hypothesis generation is an iterative activity that guides deeper investigation and modeling.
